home_article_h1: Clawd Bot: Personal AI Assistant That Actually Does Things
home_hero_badge: Open Source · Runs on Your Machine
home_hero_subtitle: The AI that actually does things.
home_hero_description: Open-source personal AI assistant that runs locally. Control via WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and more. Automates email, calendar, flight check-in, browsing, and real tasks—not just chat.
home_whatis_definition: Clawd Bot is a self-hosted, locally-running AI assistant that can perform real tasks—emails, calendar, flight check-in, browsing, and more—not just give advice.
home_whatis_diff: Unlike typical chatbots, it actually executes actions on your behalf instead of only suggesting what to do.
home_whyspecial_item1_desc: Data stays on your machine; no cloud dependency for your personal data.
home_whyspecial_item2_desc: WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, iMessage and more.
home_whyspecial_item3_desc: Browser, shell, files, forms—actually runs tasks, not just suggestions.
home_whyspecial_item4_desc: Skills and plugins (e.g. ClawdHub) to extend what it can do.
home_freesafe_freeBody: Yes. Clawd Bot is open source (MIT) and self-hosted for free. Cloud model APIs are pay-per-use; local models are completely free.
home_freesafe_freeNote: Note: the software itself is free, but you still need to pay for the hardware you run it on and for API tokens when using cloud models.
home_freesafe_safeBody: Your data stays on your machine. Our docs include a Security section. You can configure permissions and approval (Sandbox, Tool Policy, Elevated) before execution.
home_install_steps: Install → onboard/install-daemon → channels login (e.g. WhatsApp scan) → start using.
home_docs_description: Full documentation: getting started, install & update, CLI, security, platforms (macOS/Windows/Linux), channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
home_app_cliDesc: moltbot gateway, onboard, channels, etc. Run from terminal.
home_app_companionDesc: macOS app, iOS/Android nodes—pair via Gateway.
